caseNameFull: BarclaysAmerican/Credit, Inc. v. Quiller et ux. Grant v. General Electric Credit Corp. and Quiller et ux. v. BarclaysAmerican/Credit, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of American Financial Services

Association et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 85-541 granted. Certiorari denied. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and these petitions.
